source_title: Nigeria Labour Force Survey (NLFS) 2024 - Survey Methodology
methodology_notes: NLFS follows ILO guidelines with revised methodology adopted in 2022/2023
Data collection uses Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) devices
Continuous data collection approach - quarterly national-level estimates and yearly state-level results
Two-stage cluster sampling design: first stage selects Enumeration Areas, second stage selects households
Face-to-face interview approach; each team spends one week in each EA (Wednesday to Sunday) to reduce proxy response
Three teams per state in Q1 (January-March), reverting to two teams from Q2 onwards
Each team covers 8 EAs in Q1 and 4 EAs per month from Q2
Training conducted at two levels: Training of Trainers (ToT) and Training of Enumerators (ToE)
ToE training held at six zonal centers across Nigeria
Real-time data transmission and quality checks by data editors

definitions.employed: Working age population who during the reference period were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit (at least 1 hour in last 7 days)
definitions.unemployed: Not in employment, actively searching and available (did nothing for pay or profit)
definitions.labour_force: Working Age Population (15 years and above) that are employed and unemployed
definitions.underemployed: Worked less than 40 hours in a week but willing and available for more hours of work
definitions.informal_employment: Employees not protected by national labour legislation; entrepreneurs in informal units; contributing family workers
definitions.subsistence_farmers: Farmers growing crops solely to meet household needs, produce mainly not sold in markets
definitions.discouraged_jobseekers: Persons outside labour force who wanted employment and were available but did not search due to market-related reasons

sample_design.coverage: All 36 states + FCT, urban and rural areas

data_coverage: All 36 states of the Federation and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). Urban and rural areas covered. Continuous data collection for quarterly national estimates and annual state-level results.
